result.instructions: Tools for Tito, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Tito data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run tito_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run tito_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run tito_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. tito_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: tito_whoami
tools.title: Check the API token
tools.description: Confirm the API token works and list the account slugs it can reach, plus its lookup mode (live or test — a token only sees tickets and registrations of its own mode). Call this first to discover account_slug. Tito: GET /hello.

tools.name: tito_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List an account's events: upcoming (default), past or archived. Each has its slug, title, dates, location, currency, live/test_mode flags and public URL. Tito: GET /:account/events, /events/past, /events/archived.

account_slug.description: The account slug (the first part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>). Optional if TITO_ACCOUNT is set; tito_whoami lists the accounts this token can reach.

scope.description: Which events: upcoming (default), past or archived.

page_size.description: Results per page (page[size]), 1-1000. Tito's default is 100.

tools.name: tito_get_event
tools.title: Get one event
tools.description: Fetch a single event by slug: title, description, dates and times, time zone, location, currency, live/test_mode, and its releases. Tito: GET /:account/:event.

account_slug.description: The account slug (the first part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>). Optional if TITO_ACCOUNT is set; tito_whoami lists the accounts this token can reach.

event_slug.description: The event slug (the second part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>), e.g. 2026.

tools.name: tito_list_releases
tools.title: List releases (ticket types)
tools.description: List an event's releases — Tito's ticket types — with price, quantity, tickets_count sold, sold_out / off_sale / secret flags, sale window and share_url. Tito: GET /:account/:event/releases.

account_slug.description: The account slug (the first part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>). Optional if TITO_ACCOUNT is set; tito_whoami lists the accounts this token can reach.

event_slug.description: The event slug (the second part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>), e.g. 2026.

page_size.description: Results per page (page[size]), 1-1000. Tito's default is 100.

tools.name: tito_get_release
tools.title: Get one release
tools.description: Fetch a single release (ticket type) by slug, with pricing, capacity, sales counts (full-price, discounted, free, voided), questions and activities. Tito: GET /:account/:event/releases/:release_slug.

account_slug.description: The account slug (the first part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>). Optional if TITO_ACCOUNT is set; tito_whoami lists the accounts this token can reach.

event_slug.description: The event slug (the second part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>), e.g. 2026.

tools.name: tito_list_tickets
tools.title: List tickets (attendees)
tools.description: List an event's tickets — one per attendee — newest first, with name, email, company, reference, release, price paid and state. Filter by free text (name, email, phone, reference, company, tag), state, type, release, activity, and created/updated time. Void tickets are excluded unless states includes 'void'. Tito: GET /:account/:event/tickets.

account_slug.description: The account slug (the first part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>). Optional if TITO_ACCOUNT is set; tito_whoami lists the accounts this token can reach.

event_slug.description: The event slug (the second part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>), e.g. 2026.

q.description: Free-text search: email, name, phone, slug, reference, company or tag.

states.description: Only these states (search[states][]). 'archived' also includes tickets of archived releases.

types.description: manual = added by an organiser, standard = ordered by a customer (search[types][]).

release_slugs.description: Only tickets of these releases, by release slug (search[release_ids][]).

activity_ids.description: Only tickets attached to these activity ids (search[activity_ids][]).

created_after.description: Only tickets created after this time (search[created_at][gt]), e.g. 2026-01-01T09:00:00+UTC. Without the +UTC suffix Tito uses the event's own time zone.

created_before.description: Only tickets created before this time (search[created_at][lt]), e.g. 2026-01-01T09:00:00+UTC. Without the +UTC suffix Tito uses the event's own time zone.

updated_after.description: Only tickets updated after this time (search[updated_at][gt]), e.g. 2026-01-01T09:00:00+UTC. Without the +UTC suffix Tito uses the event's own time zone.

sort.description: Sort attribute (search[sort]). Default created_at, newest first.

view.description: Response view. Lists default to 'short'; 'extended' includes associated records but can be slow and large.

page_size.description: Results per page (page[size]), 1-1000. Tito's default is 100.

Tito: GET /:account/:event/registrations.

event_slug.description: The event slug (the second part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>), e.g. 2026.

view.description: Response view. Lists default to 'short'; 'extended' includes associated records but can be slow and large.

tools.name: tito_create_discount_code
tools.title: Create a discount code
tools.description: Create a discount code for an event. type is PercentOffDiscountCode (value = percent) or MoneyOffDiscountCode (value = flat amount off per ticket, in the event currency). Undo by editing it (e.g. quantity or end_at) with tito_update_discount_code. Tito: POST /:account/:event/discount_codes.

account_slug.description: The account slug (the first part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>). Optional if TITO_ACCOUNT is set; tito_whoami lists the accounts this token can reach.

event_slug.description: The event slug (the second part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>), e.g. 2026.

code.description: The code attendees enter, e.g. SAVE10.

type.description: PercentOffDiscountCode = percentage off; MoneyOffDiscountCode = flat amount off per ticket.

value.description: The amount off per ticket as a decimal string, e.g. "10.0".

end_at.description: When the code stops working (ISO 8601 datetime).

start_at.description: When the code starts working (ISO 8601 datetime).

quantity.description: How many tickets can use this code in total.

max_quantity_per_release.description: The discount applies to at most this many tickets per release.

min_quantity_per_release.description: The discount applies only if at least this many tickets are selected.

release_ids.description: Release ids the code applies to (empty = all).

only_show_attached.description: When the code is applied, show only the releases attached to it. Default false.

reveal_secret.description: Reveal secret releases when the code is applied. Default false.

tools.name: tito_update_discount_code
tools.title: Update a discount code
tools.description: Change an existing discount code — its code, value, quantity, validity window or attached releases. Only the fields you pass are sent. To retire a code without deleting it, set end_at to now. Tito: PATCH /:account/:event/discount_codes/:discount_code_id.

account_slug.description: The account slug (the first part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>). Optional if TITO_ACCOUNT is set; tito_whoami lists the accounts this token can reach.

event_slug.description: The event slug (the second part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>), e.g. 2026.

value.description: New amount off per ticket as a decimal string, e.g. "15.0".

end_at.description: When the code stops working (ISO 8601 datetime).

start_at.description: When the code starts working (ISO 8601 datetime).

quantity.description: How many tickets can use this code in total.

max_quantity_per_release.description: The discount applies to at most this many tickets per release.

min_quantity_per_release.description: The discount applies only if at least this many tickets are selected.

release_ids.description: Release ids the code applies to (empty = all).

only_show_attached.description: When the code is applied, show only the releases attached to it. Default false.

reveal_secret.description: Reveal secret releases when the code is applied. Default false.

tools.name: tito_create_ticket
tools.title: Issue a ticket manually
tools.description: Issue a ticket for a release without a checkout — e.g. a speaker, sponsor or comp ticket. Tito creates a manual registration for it. This creates a real ticket that counts against the release's capacity (undo only by voiding it in the Tito dashboard). Tito: POST /:account/:event/tickets.

account_slug.description: The account slug (the first part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>). Optional if TITO_ACCOUNT is set; tito_whoami lists the accounts this token can reach.

event_slug.description: The event slug (the second part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>), e.g. 2026.

release_id.description: The release to issue from — its slug (e.g. speaker) or numeric id.

price.description: Price recorded for the ticket as a decimal string, e.g. "0.0".

tools.name: tito_update_ticket
tools.title: Update a ticket's attendee details
tools.description: Correct a ticket's attendee details — name, email, company, phone, tags or metadata. Only the fields you pass are sent, and no email is sent to anyone (unlike a reassignment, which this server does not do). Tito: PATCH /:account/:event/tickets/:ticket_slug.

account_slug.description: The account slug (the first part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>). Optional if TITO_ACCOUNT is set; tito_whoami lists the accounts this token can reach.

event_slug.description: The event slug (the second part of https://ti.to/<account>/<event>), e.g. 2026.
